mission.zh: Fusion Research Atlas 是一个开放协作、由科学证据驱动、持续演化的聚变科学问题与研究进展图谱。
mission.en: Fusion Research Atlas is an open, collaborative and evolving atlas of scientific questions and research progress in fusion science, organized around scientific evidence.

goals.zh: 识别重要聚变科学现象
goals.en: Identify important phenomena in fusion science

goals.zh: 梳理已有理论与实验认识
goals.en: Organize existing theoretical and experimental understanding

goals.zh: 发现模型局限和科学问题
goals.en: Expose model limitations and scientific questions

goals.zh: 跟踪证据与科学认识变化
goals.en: Track changes in evidence and understanding

goals.zh: 推进科学问题之间的联系研究

scope.zh: 输运通量、源项及剖面演化

questions.zh: 源项与向内对流如何影响密度峰化？
questions.en: How do sources and inward convection affect density peaking?

scope.zh: 微观驱动、非线性相互作用与跨尺度耦合
scope.en: Microscopic drives, nonlinear interactions and cross-scale coupling.

questions.zh: 哪些不稳定性可以区分候选输运机制？
questions.en: Which instabilities distinguish candidate transport mechanisms?

name.zh: MHD 与等离子体稳定性

scope.zh: 宏观平衡、稳定性与瞬态事件
scope.en: Macroscopic equilibrium, stability and transient events.

questions.zh: 哪些稳定性边界限制运行范围？
questions.en: Which stability boundaries limit the operating space?

scope.zh: 功率沉积、电流驱动效率与剖面响应
scope.en: Power deposition, current-drive efficiency and profile response.

questions.zh: 如何区分加热对剖面的不同作用？
questions.en: How can distinct heating effects on profiles be separated?

name.zh: 边缘与等离子体壁相互作用

scope.zh: 边界输运、排热与壁材料响应
scope.en: Boundary transport, exhaust and material response.

questions.zh: 边界条件怎样约束芯部研究？
questions.en: How do boundary conditions constrain core studies?

scope.zh: 聚变产物、自加热与耦合效应
scope.en: Fusion products, self-heating and coupled effects.

questions.zh: 怎样检验自加热下的候选反馈？
questions.en: How can candidate feedbacks under self-heating be tested?

scope.zh: 测量可观测性、标定与不确定度

questions.zh: 怎样的测量能区分竞争解释？

scope.zh: 多物理耦合、预测验证与控制设计
scope.en: Coupled physics, predictive validation and control design.

questions.zh: 模型预测如何经独立数据检验？
questions.en: How can independent data test model predictions?

action.zh: 明确可观测现象和指标。
action.en: Define an observable phenomenon and metric.

update.zh: 重复观察与标定支持后更新。
update.en: Update after repeatable observations and calibration support.

action.zh: 梳理理论、实验和适用条件。

input.zh: 文献、物理规律与已有模型
input.en: Literature, physical laws and existing models

update.zh: 新来源改变适用范围时修订。
update.en: Revise when new sources change applicability.

action.zh: 将模型不足转化为明确问题。
action.en: Turn model limitations into explicit questions.

input.zh: 未解释现象与模型局限

output.zh: 带边界条件的研究问题

update.zh: 新的缺口或边界出现时修订。
update.en: Revise when new gaps or boundaries emerge.

action.zh: 提出可区分的机制预测。

update.zh: 预测与证据冲突时修改或放弃。
update.en: Modify or reject when predictions conflict with evidence.

action.zh: 核对来源、物理条件和支持范围。
action.en: Check provenance, conditions and support scope.

input.zh: 论文、实验、模拟或数学推导

update.zh: 证据或不确定度变化时重评。
update.en: Reassess when evidence or uncertainty changes.

action.zh: 设计能区分竞争解释的实验或模拟。
action.en: Design experiments or simulations that discriminate explanations.

input.zh: 预测、误差模型与测量能力
input.en: Predictions, error models and measurement capability

output.zh: 可执行方案和判别准则
output.en: An executable plan with decision criteria

update.zh: 实际结果按预设准则检验假设。
update.en: Test hypotheses against actual results and predefined criteria.

action.zh: 依据新证据保留或修正认识。
action.en: Retain or revise understanding using new evidence.

update.zh: 不以书目核验代替科学验证。
update.en: Never replace scientific validation with metadata checks.

principles.zh: 科学问题组织研究，物理规律奠定理论基础。
principles.en: Questions organize research; physical laws provide the theoretical foundation.

principles.zh: 实验、模拟、数学与文献构成不同证据。
principles.en: Experiments, simulations, mathematics and literature provide distinct evidence.

principles.zh: 新假设必须提出可区分、可证伪的预测。
principles.en: New hypotheses require distinguishable, falsifiable predictions.

principles.zh: 科学认识可以随新证据修正。
principles.en: Scientific understanding may be revised with new evidence.

description.zh: 提出具体问题及其研究范围。
description.en: Propose a specific question and its research scope.

description.zh: 提供可追溯来源并说明支持范围。
description.en: Provide traceable sources and their support scope.

description.zh: 提出相反证据或竞争解释。
description.en: Offer counterevidence or a competing explanation.

description.zh: 提出可执行且可区分机制的方案。
description.en: Propose an executable plan that discriminates mechanisms.
